setups.suggest: In most cases, you will have best stats on Jeronimo’s raw stats, so using equal formation with slightly more marksmen troops works the best.
Mainly for people that didn’t go for Jeronimo yet, and giving opportunity to use Jeronimo for joining rallies.
For F2P, it is recommended to always use the best three heroes you have for calling a rally. In Generation 1, it is Sergey, Molly, and Bahiti.
Alonso will boost damage a lot due to his widget. From Generation 2 and above, you will usually use either Jeronimo or Natalia.
Use Natalia in Generation 2 and above only if Jeronimo is not maxed in stars and widget level.
There is no F2P hero with a rally widget yet, so use an equal formation with slightly more Marksman troops.
Natalia performed better in Generation 3 thanks to two lethality widgets and one attack widget.
Use Jeronimo instead if Natalia is not maxed in stars and widgets.
Generation 3 gives you your first rally widget hero, making it a good time to try new formations.
This setup uses two lethality widgets and one attack widget. Thirty percent Lancer troops work well with Reina’s third skill, especially when Lancers have reached FC5.
Use Natalia if she has better star and widget levels. Lynn’s third skill works well with a Marksman-heavy formation.
Lynn’s third skill works best when you focus on a heavy Marksman formation.
In Generation 5, Alonso can be retired. Gwen has a similar widget but better hero skills. A heavy Marksman formation works well.
This setup uses Mia and Gwen to support a heavy Marksman formation.
Hector replaces Flint as the rally Infantry hero. You can safely use up to twenty percent Infantry.
Even without a rally widget, Wayne’s critical rate skill can provide better total rally damage than Gwen.
Mia’s skills can boost Wayne’s damage further when her effects trigger.
Because of Renee’s skills, use twenty percent Lancers or part of her damage boost may be lost.
Bradley is the newest-generation hero with very high Marksman stats, resulting in a large Marksman attack value.
This composition allows Bradley and Mia to join other players’ rallies while keeping your own rally strong.
Bradley provides high Marksman stats, while Mia can further increase Marksman attack.
Sonya mainly supports Lancer troops and Hendrik is mostly defensive, so the previous Marksman-heavy setup remains effective for Bear Hunt.
If Mia is not maxed, use Sonya with thirty percent Lancers so her skills have an impact.
Hector remains more suitable than the newest-generation Infantry hero for a Bear Hunt rally.
Fred is not especially compatible with Bradley, while Xura focuses more on enemy troops and is therefore less suitable for Bear Hunt.
If you do not have Jeronimo, Hector can still be used as the rally Infantry hero. Magnus may also be considered depending on upgrades.
Although Fred becomes available in Generation 9, Mia has more useful Bear Hunt skills and stronger damage scaling from her widget.
Blanchette is extremely effective because all of her relevant skills increase damage. Freya is not recommended for this setup.
This setup is close to the P2W composition. Use Gregory when Jeronimo is unavailable, although Hector may remain competitive depending on hero upgrades.
Blanchette appears in Lucky Wheel events and provides very high damage for Bear Hunt rallies.
Rufus can increase attack through his skill, while his widget also increases attack. Rufus and Mia provide strong combined attack bonuses.
This setup is similar to the main P2W Bear Hunt composition, with Hector replacing Jeronimo.
Blanchette remains a strong Lucky Wheel option when you cannot obtain enough Rufus fragments.
